metadata.description: Warli Paintings has made a name for itself all over the world today. Warli painting has reached the canvas from the mud walls of the tribals. Now this painting is being done on silk sarees, shirts and home furnishings. AYUS is an organization who is helping the local warli artists by providing them orders of art works.
